briefdescription.para: macOS debug session implementation using LLVM's liblldb SB API.

detaileddescription.para: Platform counterpart to Session.cpp (Windows dbgeng). Implements the whole Session interface from Session.h using lldb::SBDebugger, SBTarget, SBProcess, SBThread, and SBFrame. The file holds the lifecycle, the event dispatch that pollEvents runs for process, stop, exit, and breakpoint events, the stop-reason and process-state handlers that fire events on Session::events, breakpoint creation and location lookup, thread and frame queries, variable inspection, expression evaluation, and getExceptionName.
Threading model: the engine context makes every SB API call, except wake and cancel, which the reader thread calls. pollEvents drives the event handlers, which fire events on Session::events.
Lifecycle: initialize → (launch | attach) → pollEvents loop → shutdown.
